_why: W4 Emberdraft (languages step 2). Emberdraft data keeps English ids the code compares (roles, slots, tiers); the player sees them through edRoleTxt / edCompTxt / edCompStat / edTierTxt / edRankKit / edSynTxt (draft.* keys).

tables.ED_FINISHED: names: finished item proper names (component pair -> item name)
tables.ED_ITEM_CLS: code: item name -> role id; shown via edRoleTxt
tables.ED_SYN: code: role ids + synergy text fallback; shown via edSynTxt (draft.syn_*)
tables.ED_COMP: code: slot ids; shown via edCompTxt (draft.comp_*)
tables.ED_COMP_TXT: code: only the number is read (edCompStat -> draft.stat_*)
tables.ED_TIERS: code: legacy tier ids (v640 no tiers); shown via edTierTxt
tables.ED_CREST: code: slot -> role id; shown via edRoleTxt
tables.ED_AVATARS: names: avatar creature names; idle/walk = GLB animation clip names

functions.edRole: code: 'Warrior' is a role id (shown via edRoleTxt)
functions.edBookHtml: code: role id loop arrays; headings shown via edRoleTxt

patterns.why: mode name + separator; the rest of the line is draft.round_lc
